title: VTC Admin Actions — List — payload
description: Enumerate the administrative actions a Verifiable Trust Community holds that the caller is entitled to see, one page at a time, from one of four views. The single-record sibling is vtc/admin/actions/show/0.1. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

view.description: `waitingForMe` — open actions on which the caller is an eligible approver or acknowledger and has not yet decided. `requestedByMe` — open actions the caller requested. `history` — closed actions the caller requested, decided, or (with the audit-read capability) any closed action, newest first. `all` — every action the caller may see, open and closed.

since.description: Only with `view: history`: return actions closed at or after this instant. Supplied with any other view it is refused with `invalidFilter` rather than ignored, so a caller never reads a silently unfiltered page as a filtered one.

limit.description: Maximum number of actions in the page. The community MAY return fewer.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token from a previous page's `nextCursor`, valid only with the same `view` and `since` it was issued for.

Response.title: VTC Admin Actions — List — response payload
Response.description: One page of actions and the caller's badge counts. Failures use trust-task-error, not this shape.

actions.description: The page, in the view's order: open views by `expiresAt` soonest first (non-expiring last, then by `createdAt`), `history` by `closedAt` newest first, `all` open-before-closed in those orders. An empty array is a successful answer: nothing in this view.

nextCursor.description: Present when more actions follow. Pass it back as `cursor` with the same `view` and `since`.

counts.description: Totals across the whole collection, not the page — what a console badge shows. Computed for the caller regardless of which `view` was requested.

waitingForMe.description: Open actions awaiting the caller's decision or acknowledgement.
